name: Sanibel Causeway (Causeway Blvd) — multiple span/approach collapses
source_note: Causeway sections washed out during landfall on the afternoon of 2022-09-28 EDT (landfall 19:05Z at Cayo Costa); collapse widely confirmed by aerial imagery on 2022-09-29. FDOT/Lee County reopened a temporary repaired causeway to residents on 2022-10-19 (about three weeks after the storm). Exact hour of failure is not public; start is set to ~1 hour after landfall. Reconstructed from public news/FDOT statements — not an official closure log. Kingsley: verify against FDOT releases and refine.

name: Pine Island Rd (SR 78) at Matlacha Pass — roadway washout
source_note: The only road link to Matlacha and Pine Island washed out during landfall on 2022-09-28; Pine Island was cut off. Lee County/FDOT completed a temporary fill-and-pave repair and reopened the road on 2022-10-05. Start time set to ~1 hour after landfall (exact failure hour not public). Reconstructed from public reports — Kingsley: verify and refine.

name: I-75 at the Myakka River (North Port / Venice) — river flooding
source_note: Interstate 75 was closed in both directions around the Myakka River crossing (North Port area, Sarasota County) on 2022-10-01 because of record river flooding several days after landfall, and reopened the next day.
